verdict.rationale:
DeepInfra's docs show broad API coverage matching most UI-visible offerings — chat/completions, embeddings, vision, image/video generation, speech, private model deployment, and GPU clusters are all exposed via API endpoints or SSH access, suggesting strong functional parity. However, there's no explicit vendor statement guaranteeing 1:1 UI/API parity, and the probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (llms.txt, docs.md, openapi.json all 404), which undercuts confidence that ALL UI actions (e.g., billing/account management, dashboard configuration) are scriptable via API.
missing for 10: explicit parity statement, OpenAPI spec confirming complete endpoint coverage, evidence that account/billing/dashboard actions are API-accessible.
